assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a 1536x1024 wide editorial artwork of MO Co. from Adventure Time, based on the factory depicted in Be More. It MUST be in the dry beige desert Bad Lands, a dilapidated ancient industrial factory, not a modern green campus. A cluster of aged mint-green refinery-like cylindrical towers and round tanks, flat and domed roofs, bent pipes connecting them, antennae and vents, lower parts half-buried in pale sand. One tall cylindrical tower at the left, long low rounded factory at the right, smaller structures between, pipes curling above. A recessed dark entrance and tiny rail/tram line suggest vast subterranean facilities. No gardens, no lakes, no mountains with greenery, no shiny new architecture. Preserve the whimsical simple geometry and lonely warmth of Adventure Time in a sophisticated tactile 3D miniature render, matte enamel, light wear, soft late afternoon desert light, pale yellow sky, sage mint and petrol details, generous negative sky. Entire complex visible in center 70%. No characters needed. No text or logos or UI. This is an original illustrative interpretation, not an official frame.

Use case: stylized-concept. Generate 1536x1024 wide editorial artwork of the underground MO robot community from Adventure Time episode Be More. The architecture encloses a friendly community of MANY small diverse MOs, with simple toy-like rounded RECTANGULAR and cubic pastel bodies, small inset screen faces with dot eyes, thin rubber arms and legs, varied lavender, pale blue, mint, cream and pink colors, varying proportions. A wide flat rectangular MO, a small cube MO, a tall rectangular MO, no hero character. Some chatting on walkways, some repairing a small module at a workbench in foreground. Faithful simple Adventure Time MO design language, translated into tactile matte painted miniature 3D matching a friendly BMO render, soft edges, atmospheric warm industrial light, sense of legacy and community. No windows to gardens, no plants, no modern office. Croppable central composition. No words, logos, text, or watermarks.

Tactile matte enamel miniature 3D aesthetic with the simple whimsical retrofuturism of Adventure Time; soft worn edges, petrol navy, muted sage mint, cream and restrained amber lighting.
